//: The one Node file that also writes browser code: the callbacks browser-check.ts hands to page.evaluate() run inside the page, so they need DOM globals, while the file around them needs node:fs. Neither of the other two configs can express that, and widening the main lib to cover it would let `document` typecheck across the whole build and harness, which is what ADR-0013 exists to prevent. Its Node-side imports are still checked without DOM by tsconfig.json, which is what keeps that invariant true.
